name: Harness RSI Evidence Dataset
unit: category-source record; not an individual intervention or independent experiment
annotation_basis: AI-assisted manual screening of the existing curated evidence text. Structured signals link to exact excerpts of that text and inherit its primary-source locators. This release is not a new independent primary-source audit or experimental reproduction.
license_status: No dataset-specific reuse license has been granted. Public access is not a blanket license; source materials retain their own rights.
limitations: Outcome and retention screening is partial and not a representative sample. Unscreened records are not negative-free records.
One record can contain several differently scoped signals. Signals are not independent trials and must not be used to estimate an intervention success rate.
Unreported failures cannot be recovered from the source literature; this dataset does not eliminate publication or survivorship bias.
A null field means not assessed in this annotation pass, not absent or not reported in the original paper.
A frozen task set alone does not isolate component-level causality; models, budgets, selection access and combined changes also matter.
